critical_items.note: Form C XML gives issuer, intermediary, amounts and deadline. Offering file no. 020-37424 appears only in pack metadata.
Form of SAFE (Series 2026) is Exhibit B on doc 6 pages 55-66; it is an unsigned template. Note differences between the Form C summary and the SAFE text.
$1.00 per SAFE unit (arbitrary); $15,000,000 pre-money valuation cap; no discount rate found. Share-based price is not defined at issuance.
Minimum $100, maximum $124,000 (issuer may change). Issuer-side intermediary fees stated; investor-side fees not stated in the cited text, so the user should confirm at approval.
Reviewed (not audited) statements for years ended 2025-12-31 and 2024-12-31 with a going-concern paragraph. Latest cash figure of 2026-06-30 is issuer-stated only.
Platform page was not reachable; closing status 'none_reported'. The deadline of 2026-12-18 is not proof the offering is open or accepting funds.

Conversion terms (cap, discount, MFN) of the existing $5,096,791 SAFEs and the per-share impact of their conversion; fully diluted share count including SAFEs

Investor-side fees and the final custodian entity (BitGo Bank & Trust N.A. vs BitGo Trust Company, Inc.)
Revenue by channel, customer concentration, retailer contracts, and basis for the '$100K MoM run rate' and '1800 doors' claims

convertible_instruments.instrument: Existing SAFEs (incl. $99,937 Crowd SAFEs held by the Intermediary)
convertible_instruments.note: Valuation cap of $15,000,000 disclosed; other terms (discount, MFN) not detailed in the pack. Carried at $5,007,597 as a liability at 2025-12-31.
$15,000,000 pre-money valuation cap; target $75,000, maximum $1,000,000; purchase amount converts on an Equity Financing of at least $1,000,000. Plus 1.5% of securities sold to the intermediary.

valuation_inputs.note: Price of $1.00 is the SAFE purchase unit, not a share price. The cap is pre-money and excludes SAFEs and convertible notes from the denominator, so existing SAFEs may convert on top. Software should compute implied values; issued shares are 1,000,000 and authorized shares must not be used for value.
